name: com.binpack.enterprise
description: High-throughput domain-aware compression, virtual texturing & OTA patching engine for Unity. Up to 1+ GB/s asset decompression, O(1) random-access chunk streaming, zero-allocation API, and bounded memory usage (<= 64 MB).

samples.description: Demonstrates high-speed runtime compression, async decompression, zero-allocation buffers, and O(1) random-access archive chunk streaming.
